data.body: CORRECTION + AC reconciliation (supersedes the earlier 'live-Cloud mutation infeasible' feasibility comment). Live-REB mutation IS feasible and safe when bounded: 'rebar bridge check-access' against live REB passed CREATE/LABEL/PROPERTY_WRITE/PROPERTY_READ/DELETE (self-cleaning, always deletes in finally); only STEP_JQL_SEARCH flaked on Cloud search-index eventual-consistency lag (fixable with backoff). The earlier over-generalization of the live_jira_cloud_s3 suite's 'cardinal read-only rule' to ALL Cloud access was the error. The Live-External AC has been amended to a faithful, safety-scoped form: DC = full ephemeral multi-issue reconcile; Cloud = the same coordinator create/binding-lifecycle + commit-unknown + fuse paths BOUNDED to uniquely-labeled throwaway issues always deleted (no shared-prod write-back) + a self-cleaning capability probe. Implementation tracked under task 1d21-887e (drafty-actuarial-noddy).
